results.title: Devon Energy to Sell Eagle Ford Assets to Crescent Energy
results.summary: Devon Energy agreed on October 8, 2026, to transfer its Eagle Ford business to Crescent Energy in a cash transaction. The package covers about 90,000 net acres in Texas and accounts for approximately 4% of Devon’s total BOE output. Devon plans to direct after-tax proceeds toward repurchases and debt reduction, with completion targeted around year-end 2026 pending approvals and customary conditions.

results.title: Samsung posts record Q3 operating profit above 100 trillion won
results.summary: Samsung Electronics reported a third‑quarter operating profit of 107.4 trillion won, the first time a South Korean company has topped the 100 trillion‑won mark. Revenue reached 195 trillion won, driven by a surge in memory‑chip sales linked to AI data‑center demand. The operating margin rose to 55.1%, the highest in the company’s history. The results were announced on 8 October 2026.

results.title: Ultragenyx agrees to sell priority review voucher for $210 million
results.summary: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical entered a definitive agreement to sell its Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher for $210 million. The company received the voucher after the FDA approved Genglycos for glycogen storage disease type Ia. Completion remains contingent on customary conditions, including the Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period.
